# 7. DIRECTOR-ACTOR NETWORK

```{r}

#1.Load required packages
library(tidyverse)
library(igraph)
library(visNetwork)
library(scales)
library(htmlwidgets)
setwd("D:/work/JHU/Final-project")
movies <- readRDS("data/movies_clean.rds")

```

```{r}
#2.Construct the director–actor collaboration statistics.}
collab_stats <- movies %>%
  mutate(
    primary_director = str_split(Director, ", ", simplify = TRUE)[, 1],
    primary_actor    = str_split(Actors,   ", ", simplify = TRUE)[, 1]
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(primary_director), primary_director != "",
    !is.na(primary_actor),    primary_actor    != ""
  ) %>%
  group_by(primary_director, primary_actor) %>%
  summarise(
    collaborations = n(),
    total_revenue  = sum(BoxOffice_adjusted, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_rating     = mean(imdbRating, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups        = "drop"
  )

```

```{r}
#3.Select important edges, build the igraph object, and detect communities.

min_collab <- 2    
n_edges    <- 120  

edges_df <- collab_stats %>%
  filter(collaborations >= min_collab) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_revenue)) %>%
  slice_head(n = n_edges) %>%
  transmute(
    from   = primary_director,
    to     = primary_actor,
    weight = total_revenue,
    collab = collaborations
  )


g <- graph_from_data_frame(edges_df, directed = FALSE)


cl <- cluster_louvain(g, weights = E(g)$weight)


directors <- unique(edges_df$from)
actors    <- unique(edges_df$to)

nodes_df <- tibble(
  id        = V(g)$name,
  label     = V(g)$name,
  role      = case_when(
    id %in% directors ~ "Director",
    id %in% actors    ~ "Actor",
    TRUE              ~ "Other"
  ),
  community = factor(membership(cl)),
  degree    = degree(g),
  strength  = strength(g, weights = E(g)$weight)
) %>%
  mutate(
    
    group = paste0("Community ", community),
    
    value = rescale(strength, to = c(10, 40)),
    
    title = paste0(
      "<b>", label, "</b><br>",
      "Role: ", role, "<br>",
      "Community: ", community, "<br>",
      "Total revenue: ", dollar(strength), "<br>",
      "Degree: ", degree
    ),
    
    shape = ifelse(role == "Director", "dot", "triangle")
  )

```

```{r}
#4.Prepare edge data for use in visNetwork.
edges_vis <- edges_df %>%
  mutate(
    width = rescale(log10(weight + 1), to = c(1, 8)),
    title = paste0(
      "<b>", from, " – ", to, "</b><br>",
      "Collaborations: ", collab, "<br>",
      "Total revenue: ", dollar(weight)
    )
  )

```

```{r}
#5.Generate the interactive community visualization.
vis_cluster <- visNetwork(nodes_df, edges_vis, main = list(
  text  = "Director–Actor Collaboration Communities (Interactive)",
  style = "font-size:26px; font-weight: bold; color: #222;"
)) %>%
  visOptions(
    highlightNearest = list(enabled = TRUE, degree = 1, hover = TRUE),
    nodesIdSelection = TRUE   
  ) %>%
  visLegend(
    useGroups = TRUE,
    position  = "right"
  ) %>%
  visEdges(
    smooth = FALSE,
    color  = list(color = "grey70", highlight = "orange")
  ) %>%
 visNodes(
    borderWidth = 2,
    color = list(
      border = "#111"
    ),
    font = list(size = 20, color = "#000")
  ) %>%
   visLegend(
    addNodes = list(
      list(label = "Director", shape = "dot",      color = "grey"),
      list(label = "Actor",    shape = "triangle", color = "grey")
    ),
    useGroups = FALSE,
    position = "right"
   )%>%
  visInteraction(
    dragNodes  = TRUE,
    dragView   = TRUE,
    zoomView   = TRUE
  ) %>%
  visPhysics(
    solver = "barnesHut",
    barnesHut = list(
      gravitationalConstant = -2500,
      springLength          = 180,
      springConstant        = 0.02
    ),
    stabilization = TRUE
 ) %>%
  visLayout(randomSeed = 123) %>%        
  visConfigure(enabled = FALSE)         

vis_cluster

```

```{r}
#6.Export the result as an HTML webpage.
saveWidget(
  vis_cluster,
  "director_actor_communities_interactive.html",
  selfcontained = TRUE
)

```
